editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the ARDMS Abdominal Sonography Specialty certification covering anatomy, pathology, abdominal physics, and clinical care across 165 questions.
editorial.overview: The ARDMS Abdominal Sonography Specialty certification is an evaluation covering standard clinical concepts including normal anatomy, perfusion, function, pathology, vascular abnormalities, trauma, postoperative anatomy, abdominal physics, and clinical care. It is officially certified by ARDMS (Inteleos) and is evaluated through an official 180-minute examination consisting of 165 questions designed to validate professional sonography competency.
editorial.who_should_take: Sonographers seeking professional credentialing in abdominal sonography who regularly perform diagnostic examinations in clinical settings and require formal validation of their diagnostic skills through ARDMS (Inteleos).

editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the complete test content outline across all four distinct domains. Focus heavily on pathology, vascular abnormalities, trauma, and postoperative anatomy, which accounts for forty-two percent of the overall exam content. Practice evaluating clinical data and applying equipment optimization concepts diligently before taking the 165 questions.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your testing time effectively throughout the entire 180-minute duration to successfully complete all 165 questions while carefully analyzing complex clinical scenarios and sonographic findings.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The official certification examination consists of a total of 165 questions covering four distinct content domains related to abdominal sonography practice, physics, and patient care standards.
The passing score required to successfully achieve the Abdominal Sonography Specialty certification credential is officially established at exactly 555 out of 700 possible total points.
The specialty exam is administered with a total time duration of 180 minutes to ensure all candidates have adequate time to complete all of the questions.

faq.question_title: Who certifies the abdominal sonography specialty?
faq.answer_text: The professional certification is offered and administered by ARDMS (Inteleos), which provides valid and reliable examinations designed specifically for qualified ultrasound and sonography professionals worldwide.
